text: Single API call stores information into memory (ingestion entry point)
quote: The `.remember` operation is the main ingestion entry point in Cognee v1.0. It stores information in memory with a single API call.

text: Given text, files, or URLs, Cognee ingests, chunks, extracts entities, and builds a knowledge graph in one call
quote: Give Cognee text, files, or URLs. It ingests, chunks, extracts entities, and builds the knowledge graph for you in one call.

text: A single recall operation is the main retrieval entry point, searching memory via the best available source
quote: The `.recall` operation is the main retrieval entry point in Cognee v1.0. It searches memory using the best available source for the request.

text: When no search type is given, recall() automatically classifies the query and picks the best retrieval strategy
quote: when you do not specify a search type, `recall()` classifies the query and picks the best retrieval strategy automatically

text: An improve operation enriches an existing knowledge graph after data has been ingested
quote: The `.improve` operation enriches an existing Cognee graph after data has already been ingested.

text: improve() can be used at end of a chat/agent session to bridge short-term session memory into permanent memory
quote: Use `improve()` after Remember when you want to enrich an existing graph further. Use it at the end of a chat or agent session to bridge short-term session memory into permanent memory.

text: A unified forget operation deletes a single data item, an entire dataset, or all of a user's memory (full cleanup)
quote: Single data item deletion: remove one data item from a dataset. Dataset deletion: remove an entire dataset and its graph/vector data. Full cleanup: remove everything the current user can delete.

text: Official CLI lets you remember data, enrich memory, and ask questions from the terminal without writing Python
quote: lets you run Cognee from the terminal so you can remember data, enrich memory, and ask questions without opening a Python file

text: CLI demo mode works with no API key, no embedding provider, and no network access
quote: `cognee-cli demo` gives you a working example with **no API key and no embedding provider**, on a machine with no network access

text: CLI push command uploads a local dataset's knowledge graph to Cognee Cloud
quote: `cognee-cli push` uploads a local dataset's knowledge graph to Cognee Cloud

text: CLI report command generates a Graph Insight Report describing what a dataset's graph contains
quote: `cognee-cli report` writes a Graph Insight Report describing what a dataset's graph contains

text: Connects to MCP-compatible AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, Continue, Cline, and Codex
quote: You access them through MCP-compatible AI assistants like Cursor, Claude Desktop, Continue, Cline, and Codex.

text: Provides an official MCP server bringing persistent AI memory into agent workflows
quote: Cognee MCP brings persistent AI memory to your workflow through the Model Context Protocol.

text: Single-command Docker quickstart runs the full Cognee container locally
quote: Quick start with Docker (single command): docker run --env-file ./.env -p 8000:8000 --rm -it cognee/cognee:main

text: Optional RDF/OWL ontology file acts as a reference vocabulary linking extracted entities to canonical concepts
quote: An **ontology** is an optional RDF/OWL file you can provide to Cognee. It acts as a **reference vocabulary**, making sure that entity types ("classes") and entity mentions ("individuals") extracted from your data are linked to canonical, we

text: Dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage isolate data for multiple users/organizations on one instance
quote: This system provides data isolation and access control through dataset-scoped permissions and per-dataset storage, enabling multiple users or organizations to use the same Cognee instance while keeping their data completely separate.

text: UI and all pipelines can be run entirely locally for free with no account required via start_ui()
quote: you can also run the UI and all pipelines entirely on your own machine for free, with no account required, using `cognee.start_ui()`

text: Data can be stored as permanent graph memory or fast session (short-term) memory in a single call
quote: Store data as permanent graph memory or fast session memory in one call.

text: Cognee is open source and can run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack for free, forever
quote: Cognee is open source. Run the full memory engine locally or on your own stack — free, forever.

text: Built-in data source integrations for Slack, Notion, Linear, and Google Drive
quote: Data source integrations: Slack, Notion, Linear, Google Drive

text: Connect a GitHub organization and index every covered repository into a code graph
quote: Connect a GitHub organization and index every covered repository into the code graph.

text: Can be installed as a Linear agent that autonomously answers @mentions and delegated issues from memory
quote: Install Cognee as a Linear agent that answers @mentions and delegated issues from memory, and index the workspace's issues.

text: Browser UI lets you upload data, explore knowledge graphs, run searches, and manage datasets
quote: Upload data, explore knowledge graphs, run searches, and manage datasets through the browser.

text: A session is short-term memory scoped to a user, storing an ordered list of recent interactions
quote: A session is Cognee's short-term memory for a specific user. It is identified by `(user_id, session_id)` and stores an ordered list of recent interactions.
